reason: Explain how correlated accepted models repair and break ranking pairs, and why a tiny net AUC gain does not identify precise blend weights.
scope: Fixed accepted-model score comparisons only; no selection, new weight search, audit data, model fitting or release action.
computation: Exact strict cross-class rank-discordance counts from all-row Kendall discordance minus within-positive and within-negative discordance. Require tie-free scores and brute-pair synthetic verification. Repaired/broken pair counts follow from discordance and signed AUC win-count difference.
limit: Pair counts are explanatory geometry, not independent sample size or confidence evidence. Rows, models, recipes and weights have already been adaptively reused.
